system.summary: Numerical code among Spanish words in clear: groups of four figures, groups of three, and low numbers of one or two figures followed by a small mark; what each kind stands for is not stated in this folder.
system.sibling_key: targets/reyes1886 is another system of the same archive, by its notes; not used here.
system.notes: distinct_symbols = distinct groups over the ten telegrams, low numbers included (groups_output.txt). A rebuild of the key from translated sister telegrams is under way; it will be tested under a plan that was sealed on 20 Nov 2026, before any telegram here was decoded (NOTES.md, section 7). Nothing of it is stated here, and the fields marked unknown stay so until the sealed test reports.

prior_solution.where: No reading of these telegrams and no key to their code was found in what was opened. An article of 2008 gives three examples of a word code of Díaz with another correspondent, and no table; one of the three numbers stands in one of these telegrams. Not read: Narváez 2019; Ángel Ángel and Morales-Luna 2007 and Cryptologia 33:2 (2009); pages 3 and 4 of their Ciencia y Desarrollo article of 2008; Galende 2000. Not searched: the Colección Porfirio Díaz; the Fondo Rafael Chousal. See NOTES.md, section 5.

conditions.human_role: Jacob Houtrouw chose the target, ruled on its scope and on each rule of the work, ran the blind readers' chats and sends the folder. AI models at his direction fetched the images, copied the numerals and wrote the files. No hand correction is recorded.
tools: scripts/make_data_files.py (transcription files and counts from the copy)
models: claude-opus-5-5, as it named itself (blind second readings; the auditing session)

solution.what: The ledger, print and the web searched for a reading of these telegrams or a key to their code. None found in what was opened; four works could not be opened, and four more were opened by Jacob Houtrouw and the auditing session, with no key and no clear text of these years in them, by his report (NOTES.md, section 5). An article of 2008, read in part that day, describes a word code of Díaz with another correspondent by three examples and prints no table of it.
12 images of the ten telegrams fetched from the archive's viewer (sources.tsv).
First reading of the ten telegrams from the images at full size: 360 groups among 169 words in clear.
Blind second reading of four telegrams by another AI model in a chat of its own (DLI.2.397.1, DLI.5.920.1, DLI.5.933.1, DLI.5.950.1): 123 groups, 116 with the same digits as the first reading.
Blind second reading of two more telegrams (DLI.5.910.1, DLI.5.924.1): 63 groups, 57 with the same digits. The copy keeps every reading; 40 groups are open.
Counts by width of group and the groups shared between telegrams (groups_output.txt): 194 distinct groups of three or four figures, 52 of them in more than one telegram.

A second search, on the code itself. A thesis of 2023 and an article of 2024 that use these telegrams were searched in full text by the auditing session: by its account neither prints a key. A book of 2019, known by a review, stays unread.

outcome.method_basis: The numerals are transcribed. No key and no decode is sent with this folder; a key is being rebuilt from translated sister telegrams and will be tested under a plan that was sealed on 20 Nov 2026, before any telegram here was decoded (NOTES.md, section 7).
